title: Composition-stable dimension-3 no-go
proved: If allowed finite Hilbert-space dimensions are closed under independent tensor composition and contain d>1, then d^k is allowed for every k>=1.
No singleton finite dimension class {d} with d>1 is closed under ordinary tensor composition.
If n=3 is reinterpreted as an elementary factor dimension, composition closure alone remains underdetermined because every prime p generates an analogous power family {p^k}.
falsified: PDT-II can non-circularly derive that every allowed finite system, including composites, has Hilbert dimension exactly 3 while retaining ordinary independent tensor composition.
Tensor-composition closure alone selects elementary dimension 3 over other prime local dimensions.
prior_art_boundary: Hardy, Reformulating and Reconstructing Quantum Theory, arXiv:1104.2066
